announced that [[Leonardo Araújo]], [[sporting director]], had been dismissed,{{Cite web |date=22 May 2022 |title=Leonardo sacked by PSG |url=https://www.getfootballnewsfrance.com/2022/leonardo-sacked-by-psg/ |access-date=23 May 2022 |website=Get French Football News}} and that star forward [[Kylian Mbappé]] had signed a contract extension, choosing to remain at the club.{{Cite web |date=22 May 2022 |title=Mbappé stays at PSG after rejecting Real Madrid |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/sports/football/mbappe-to-stay-at-psg-after-rejecting-real-madrid-report-7929499/ |access-date=23 May 2022 |website=The Indian Express |language=en}} The season is the first without the services of [[Ángel Di María]] at Paris Saint-Germain since the [[2014–15 Paris Saint-Germain F.C. season|2014–15 season]].{{Cite web |date=20 May 2022 |title=Paris Saint-Germain thanks Angel Di Maria |url=https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/paris-saint-germain-thanks-angel-di-maria-2021-2022 |access-date=31 May 2022 |publisher=[[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220520212626/https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/paris-saint-germain-thanks-angel-di-maria-2021-2022 |archive-date=20 May 2022 |url-status=dead}} On 31 May, PSG completed the permanent transfer Portuguese left-back [[Nuno Mendes (footballer, born 2002)|Nuno Mendes]], who signed with the club until 30 June 2026. On 10 June 2022, [[Luís Campos (football)|Luís Campos]] joined the club as Football Advisor, being responsible for recruitment of new players.{{Cite web |date=10 June 2022 |title=Luis Campos is Paris Saint-Germain new Football Advisor |url=https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/luis-campos-is-paris-saint-germain-new-football-advisor |access-date=10 June 2022 |publisher=[[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.]] |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220610104719/https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/luis-campos-is-paris-saint-germain-new-football-advisor |archive-date=10 June 2022 |url-status=dead}} Campos's first signing of the summer was Portuguese midfielder [[Vitinha (footballer, born February 2000)|Vitinha]], in a transfer worth €41.5 million.{{Cite web |date=30 June 2022 |title=Mercato: PSG offers Vitinha! (official) |url=https://california18.com/mercato-psg-offers-vitinha-official/5455582022/ |access-date=6 July 2022 |website=California18}} On 5 July 2022, [[Christophe Galtier]] replaced [[Mauricio Pochettino]] as the club's head coach, a signing which lent a lot of credibility to the club/s new policy of no "bling-bling". This was stated by the club's president at a presentation for the new head coach.{{cite web |date=5 July 2022 |title=Christophe Galtier appointed as the new coach of Paris Saint-Germain |url=https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/christophe-galtier-appointed-as-the-new-coach-of-paris-saint-germain |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220705122811/https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/christophe-galtier-appointed-as-the-new-coach-of-paris-saint-germain |archive-date=5 July 2022 |access-date=5 July 2022 |publisher=[[Paris Saint-Germain F.C.]]}} On 17 July the club confirmed the signing of [[Hugo Ekitike]] initially on a loan deal, which included a clause for a permanent transfer to the club.{{Cite news |title=PSG sign Ekitike on loan with option to buy |language=en-GB |work=BBC Sport |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/62197574 |access-date=2022-07-27}} The signing was quickly followed by reports that club were now free to pursue alternative targets in a focused manner, specifically reaching out for players from the Paris region. Though initial reports were skeptical, the club quickly proved this to be true by signing [[Nordi Mukiele]] from [[RB Leipzig]].{{Cite web |title=Nordi Mukiele signs for Paris Saint-Germain |url=https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/nordi-mukiele-signs-for-paris-saint-germain-until-2027 |access-date=2022-07-27 |website=EN.PSG.FR |language=en |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220726152105/https://en.psg.fr/teams/first-team/content/nordi-mukiele-signs-for-paris-saint-germain-until-2027 |archive-date=26 July 2022 |url-status=dead}} In continuation of the club's new transfer policy, the club then launched a bid for [[Renato Sanches]] who played for [[Lille OSC|Lille]]. After a few weeks of negotiations the player was then signed on 4 August.{{Cite web |title=Renato Sanches signs for Paris Saint-Germain
